prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
**My pick for the best all-around local option: Big Brand Tire & Service**, at **3687 Old Santa Rita Rd**. Its Pleasanton location has a strong customer rating in the results—**4.7/5 from 696 reviews**—with customers praising clear explanations, quick service, and tire work. It also offers installation and alignment. [Shop details and reviews](https://www.bigbrandtire.com/locations/3687-old-santa-rita-rd-pleasanton-ca-94588)

Other good choices, depending on what matters most:

- **Costco Tire Center**, **7200 Johnson Dr** — worth comparing if you’re a member and want the included installation and ongoing benefits such as rotations, balancing, flat repairs, and a five-year road-hazard warranty. Appointments are recommended; walk-ins depend on bay availability. [Costco tire service](https://tires.costco.com/Home?whs=202)
- **Big O Tires**, **3688A Washington St** — a convenient local alternative for buying and installing tires. [Pleasanton location](https://www.bigotires.com/location/ca/pleasanton/3688a-washington-st-94566/005024)
- **The Tire Choice**, **4216 Rosewood Rd** — another local option for tire installation and alignment. [Pleasanton location](https://locations.thetirechoice.com/ca/pleasanton/4216-rosewood-rd)

**Bottom line:** I’d start with Big Brand for service reputation, then compare its out-the-door quote with Costco if you’re a member. Ask each shop to quote the same tire model and confirm whether the price includes mounting, balancing, TPMS service, disposal, and alignment.
